/* SQL - Modelo Mais Vendido */

SELECT 
    ve.nome AS modelocarro,
    COUNT(*) AS top_auto_vendido
FROM clientes c
LEFT JOIN vendas v 
    ON v.id_clientes = c.id_clientes
LEFT JOIN veiculos ve 
    ON ve.id_veiculos = v.id_veiculos
WHERE c.data_inclusao >= '2026-03-18'
GROUP BY ve.nome
ORDER BY top_auto_vendido DESC
LIMIT 1;

/* SQL - Total Geral Vendas */


SELECT 
    COUNT(v.id_clientes) AS total_vendas,
    TO_CHAR(
        SUM(v.valor_pago),
        'FM999G999G999G990D00'
    ) AS valor_total
FROM clientes c
LEFT JOIN concessionarias cc 
    ON cc.id_concessionarias = c.id_concessionarias
LEFT JOIN vendas v 
    ON v.id_clientes = c.id_clientes
LEFT JOIN veiculos ve 
    ON ve.id_veiculos = v.id_veiculos
LEFT JOIN vendedores vend 
    ON vend.id_vendedores = v.id_vendedores
WHERE c.data_inclusao >= CURRENT_DATE
AND c.data_inclusao < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day';

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_vendas_ontem,
    SUM(valor_pago) AS valor_total_ontem,
    ve.nome AS modelocarro
FROM vendas v
LEFT JOIN veiculos ve ON ve.id_veiculos = v.id_veiculos
WHERE DATE(v.data_venda) = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day'
GROUP BY ve.nome
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    AVG(total_dia) AS media_7_dias
FROM (
    SELECT 
        DATE(data_venda) AS dia,
        COUNT(*) AS total_dia
    FROM vendas
    WHERE data_venda >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
    GROUP BY DATE(data_venda)
) t;

SELECT 
    TO_CHAR(data_venda, 'DD/MM') AS dia,
    COUNT(*) AS total
FROM vendas
WHERE data_venda >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(data_venda, 'DD/MM')
ORDER BY MIN(data_venda);

SELECT modelo, SUM(total) AS total
FROM (
    SELECT 
        ve.nome AS modelo,
        COUNT(*) AS total
    FROM vendas v
    LEFT JOIN veiculos ve 
        ON ve.id_veiculos = v.id_veiculos
    GROUP BY ve.nome, v.id_vendas
) t
GROUP BY modelo
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 5;
